critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Upper Deck Hump' primitive by increasing its length along the longitudinal axis to 60% of the fuselage length, expanding its width to match the main deck diameter, and applying a spherical fillet (radius = 15% of height) at the forward junction. Adjust the vertical profile from a flat plane to a parabolic curve with a peak height equal to 40% of the upper deck's thickness to create a bulbous volume that blends smoothly into the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck hump ends very abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the top of the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears as a flat, low-profile extension with minimal vertical curvature.
discrepancies.reference: The hump has a distinct rounded, bulbous volume that blends into the main deck.

discrepancies.observed: There is a sharp, angular intersection where the upper deck meets the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve connects the hump to the forward fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears narrow and thin relative to the main fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: The hump is wide enough to accommodate a full row of windows across its span.
